age.evidence: Adult males of C57Bl/6 mice (The Jackson Laboratory, 10-11 weeks, 23-26 g) were used in the experiments.

sex.evidence: Adult males of C57Bl/6 mice... For this reason we chose male mice for our study. ... (16 mice in each group). The control group (16 mice) obtained saline injections

dosing.doses_raw: 1 mg/ kg of body weight and administered i.p.
dosing.evidence: For 14 days, the animals were treated with mixed 5-HT 2A/2C agonist DOI (SigmaAldrich, USA)... Drugs were dissolved in saline in the concentration of 1 mg/ kg of body weight and administered i.p.

dosing.doses_raw: 1 mg/ kg of body weight and administered i.p.
dosing.evidence: For 14 days, the animals were treated with... selective 5-HT 2A agonists TCB-2 (Tocris Bioscience, UK)... Drugs were dissolved in saline in the concentration of 1 mg/ kg of body weight and administered i.p.

dosing.doses_raw: 1 mg/ kg of body weight and administered i.p.; HTR challenge: 'in the dose of 1 mg/kg and administered i.p.'
dosing.evidence: For 14 days, the animals were treated with... 25CN-NBOH (Tocris Bioscience, UK). Drugs were dissolved in saline in the concentration of 1 mg/ kg of body weight and administered i.p. Also used as an acute 1 mg/kg i.p. challenge for the head-twitch test.

group_housing.evidence: Two days before the behavioral experiments, the mice were isolated into individual cages to rule out the group effect. (Single-housed during behavioural testing; prior housing density not explicitly stated.)

day_night_flipped.evidence: The mice were housed under standard laboratory conditions in a natural light-dark cycle (16 h light and 8 h dark)

assays.assay_description: After all behavioural procedures, chronically treated mice received an acute 25CN-NBOH challenge (1 mg/kg, i.p.); head-twitches counted for 20 min starting 5 min post-injection to assess 5-HT2A functional activity.

application_type.evidence: The drug was dissolved in saline in the dose of 1 mg/kg and administered i.p.

setup_restrain.evidence: No restraint described during head-twitch observation.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the observation setting.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the observation setting.

time_to_assay.evidence: The head-twitches were measured during 20 min, 5 min after drug administration.

sample_size.evidence: Fig. 2 Head twitches induced by 25CN-NBOH (1 mg/kg) in mice chronically treated with saline, DOI, TCB-2 or 25CN-NBOH (n = 6).

outcomes.summary: Chronic treatment with DOI, TCB-2 or 25CN-NBOH significantly attenuated the head-twitch response to a 25CN-NBOH challenge, interpreted as 5-HT2A receptor desensitization.
outcomes.evidence: All the investigated drugs caused significant attenuation in the head-twitch response (F 3, 20 = 11.30, p < 0.001; Fig. 2) suggesting the desensitization of the 5-HT 2A receptors.

B1_num_measures.evidence: evaluating the number of head-twitches induced by selective 5-HT 2A agonist 25CN-NBOH

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total count over 20 min reported (Fig. 2); no time-binned analysis.

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is excluded as ethological by rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: No automated classification described; head-twitches counted.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Observation setting not described beyond standard testing.

E7_social_context.evidence: Mice were individually housed/tested; no conspecific during recording described.

D1_continuity.evidence: The head-twitches were measured during 20 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: After all behavioral procedures, the functional activity of 5-HT 2A receptors was investigated

assays.assay_description: 5-min test in an open arena after 14-day chronic treatment (saline, DOI, TCB-2, 25CN-NBOH 1 mg/kg). Distance, explored area and time in centre tracked with EthoStudio; rearings and groomings counted manually.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were dissolved in saline... and administered i.p.

setup_restrain.evidence: Open Field (OF) test was performed using an open arena

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the open arena.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the open arena.

time_to_assay.evidence: Injection of the drug was carried out at least 1 h after behavioral experiments (implies last dose given the previous day, ~<24 h before testing; exact interval not stated).

sample_size.evidence: Table 3: Data represent the mean ± SEM; n = 6 per group

outcomes.summary: Chronic treatment had a main effect on time in centre, with 25CN-NBOH showing a trend to decrease centre time (p = 0.06), interpreted as slight anxiogenic effect; no drug affected distance, explored area, rearings or groomings.
outcomes.statistics: Time in centre: F(3,20)=3.92, p<0.05; 25CN-NBOH vs saline tendency p=0.06. Explored area F(3,20)=1.92, n.s.; total distance F(3,20)=0.23, n.s.; rearings F(3,20)=0.83, n.s.; groomings F(3,20)=0.44, n.s.
outcomes.evidence: Post-hoc analysis revealed that chronic treatment with 25CN-NBOH decreased the time spent in the center of the arena (tendency p = 0.06; Table 3). All the utilized drugs failed to produce any changes in the explored area of the arena (F 3, 20 = 1.92, n.s), total distance (F 3, 20 = 0.23, n.s) and the number of rearings (F 3, 20 = 0.83, n.s) and groomings (F 3, 20 = 0.44, n.s).

B1_num_measures.evidence: the distance run and the area explored of the arena) and time in the center were measured... The number of rearings and groomings was measured manually. (5 measures)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only totals over the 5-min test reported (Table 3).

B4_ethological.evidence: The number of rearings and groomings was measured manually.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: measured automatically during a 5-min test using the original EthoStudio software (position tracking); rearing/grooming scored manually

D5_followup.evidence: Tested during ongoing daily treatment; injection given at least 1 h after behavioral experiments.

assays.assay_description: 5-min test in a plastic light-dark box; animal placed in light compartment facing aperture. Time in light/dark compartments and transitions measured with EthoStudio.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were dissolved in saline... and administered i.p.

setup_restrain.evidence: The animal was placed in the light compartment of the device facing the aperture.

time_to_assay.evidence: Injection of the drug was carried out at least 1 h after behavioral experiments (exact interval not stated).

sample_size.evidence: Table 4: Data represent the mean ± SEM; n = 6 per group

outcomes.summary: Chronic treatment with DOI, TCB-2 or 25CN-NBOH did not alter time in light/dark compartments or number of transitions; the slight anxiogenic OF effect of 25CN-NBOH was not confirmed.
outcomes.statistics: Time in dark F(3,20)=1.7, n.s.; time in light F(3,20)=1.7, n.s.; dark-light transitions F(3,20)=0.51, n.s.; light-dark transitions F(3,20)=0.29, n.s.
outcomes.evidence: The main treatment effect on the time spent in the dark (F 3, 20 = 1.7, n.s) and light (F 3, 20 = 1.7, n.s) compartments as well as number of dark-light (F 3, 20 = 0.51, n.s) and light-dark (F 3, 20 = 0.29, n.s) transitions was absent in the light-dark box test

B1_num_measures.evidence: Table 4: Duration in dark, Duration in light, Dark-light transitions, Light-dark transitions (4 measures)

B4_ethological.evidence: Zone time and transitions only (spatial measures).

B7_automated_classification.evidence: measured during a 5-min test using EthoStudio software (position tracking)

E6_spatial.evidence: number of transitions from the dark compartment to the light one

assays.assay_description: Mice placed individually in polypropylene cages (42 × 24 × 12 cm) with 20 glass marbles on 5 cm-deep sawdust, no food or water, metal grid ceiling; marbles buried ≥2/3 counted after 30 min.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were dissolved in saline... and administered i.p.

food_restriction.evidence: evenly spaced on 5 cm-deep sawdust without food or water

water_restriction.evidence: evenly spaced on 5 cm-deep sawdust without food or water

time_to_assay.evidence: Injection of the drug was carried out at least 1 h after behavioral experiments (exact interval not stated).

sample_size.evidence: Table 4: Data represent the mean ± SEM; n = 6 per group

outcomes.summary: The main effect of chronic treatment on number of marbles buried was weak and non-significant (p = 0.052); authors conclude the agonists did not affect stereotyped behaviour.
outcomes.evidence: In our study the main effect of chronic treatment on marble-burying behavior was weak (F 3, 20 = 3.06, p = 0.052; Table 4) indicating that hallucinogenic agonists failed to affect stereotyped behavior.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The number of marbles buried by at least two-thirds was counted 30 min later.

E5_enrichment.evidence: Marbles are the test stimuli, not enrichment.

D2_session_duration.evidence: The number of marbles buried... was counted 30 min later.

assays.assay_description: TSE Startle Response/PPI system; 65 dB background, 3-min adaptation, 8 signals at 15-s intervals alternating 85 dB pulse and 75 dB prepulse + 110 dB pulse. Startle amplitude and PPI (%) computed.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were dissolved in saline... and administered i.p.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only an in-session 'adaptation period (3 min)' is described, which is acclimation within the test session, not separate apparatus habituation.

setup_restrain.evidence: The animal was placed in a chamber (TSE Startle Response/PPI test system); restraint holder not explicitly described.

time_to_assay.evidence: Injection of the drug was carried out at least 1 h after behavioral experiments (exact interval not stated).

sample_size.evidence: Fig. 3 ... in mice chronically treated with saline, DOI, TCB-2 and 25CN-NBOH (n = 6).

outcomes.summary: No drug altered PPI, but treatment affected acoustic startle amplitude: chronic 25CN-NBOH increased startle amplitude, interpreted as an enhanced fear reaction.
outcomes.statistics: PPI: F(3,20)=0.75, n.s.; startle: F(3,20)=4.24, p<0.01; 25CN-NBOH vs saline p<0.05
outcomes.evidence: We have found that chronic treatment with DOI, TCB-2 and 25CN-NBOH failed to produce any changes in PPI (F 3, 20 = 0.75, n.s; Fig. 3a). However, treatment affected acoustic startle reflex (F 3, 20 = 4.24, p < 0.01). Post-hoc analysis found that 25CN-NBOH caused an increase in the range of acoustic startle reflex (p < 0.05; Fig. 3b)

B1_num_measures.evidence: startle amplitude and PPI = ((P - PP)/ P)*100%

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: average values... were calculated after four presentations

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI/startle magnitude excluded as ethological by rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: TSE Startle Response software records response amplitude, not behaviour classification.

E6_spatial.evidence: The animal was placed in a chamber

D1_continuity.evidence: After the adaptation period (3 min), sound signals (a total of 8) were fed into the chamber at an interval of 15 sec.

assays.assay_description: Hidden-platform MWM (25°C opaque water, 6-cm platform, visual cue). 4 acquisition days × 3 trials (60 s max, 15 s ITI) measuring escape latency, path, speed, cumulative distance; day 5 probe test (3 × 60 s) measuring % time in target sector. EthoStudio tracking.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were dissolved in saline... and administered i.p.

setup_restrain.evidence: an animal was released into the centers of sectors III or IV (free swimming)

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the water tank.

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water source in the tank (milk-opaque swimming water is not a water supply).

time_to_assay.evidence: Injection of the drug was carried out at least 1 h after behavioral experiments (exact interval not stated).

sample_size.evidence: half of animals (n = 8) were tested in Morris water-maze; Fig. 4 ... (n = 8)

outcomes.summary: Chronic DOI, TCB-2 or 25CN-NBOH did not affect acquisition (escape latency, cumulative distance, path, speed) or probe-test memory; all groups learned across days and spent more time in the target sector than chance.
outcomes.statistics: Drug: escape latency F(3,28)=0.91, n.s.; cumulative distance F(3,28)=0.4, n.s.; total path F(3,28)=0.34, n.s.; speed F(3,28)=0.34, n.s. Drug×day: latency F(9,84)=0.44; distance F(9,84)=0.29; path F(9,84)=1.26; speed F(9,84)=1.26, all n.s. Day: latency F(3,28)=9.32, p<0.001; path F(3,28)=36.07, p<0.001. Probe: F(1,56)=64.94, p<0.001; vs chance F(1,56)=23.45, p<0.001.
outcomes.evidence: No effect of the drug on escape latency (F 3, 28 = 0.91, n.s), cumulative distance (F 3, 28 = 0.4, n.s), total path (F 3, 28 = 0.34, n.s), and speed (F 3, 28 = 0.34, n.s) was found in the MWM... The latter indicates that all used drugs did not affect both performance and spatial memory in the MWM.

B1_num_measures.evidence: escape latency time, speed, the path traveled, cumulative distance... time spent (%) in the target sector (5 measures)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The mean values of the day trials were calculated; learning analysed across days (between-session), not within-session.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Chronic treatment with 5-HT 2A agonists failed to affect spatial memory and learning in the MWM

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Mice were tracked automatically with a web camera, and their behavior was analyzed with the EthoStudio program (position tracking)

E1_environment_type.evidence: The tank was filled with water (25°C, layer 15 cm deep).

E5_enrichment.evidence: Only platform and visual cue present.

E6_spatial.evidence: The surface of the tank was virtually divided into four sectors.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or drinking water in the maze.

D1_continuity.evidence: Mice received three acquisition trials per day for 4 consecutive days... On the fifth consecutive day, a retention test was performed.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Trial duration was limited to 60 s with 15 s inter-trial intervals (3 trials/day).

D3_recording_days.evidence: 4 consecutive days of acquisition + retention test on fifth day = 5 days

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same six assays (HTR, OFT, light-dark box, marble burying, startle/PPI, MWM); no merging or dropping needed. RT-PCR and Western blot excluded as ex vivo.
DOI set to null: not present in the markdown and candidates disagreed (null, 10.1007/s11064-020-03145-9, 10.1007/s12034-020-00764-w).
Age value set to 'adult' following the paper's explicit wording ('Adult males... 10-11 weeks').
group_housing set to 'no' because the rubric asks for housing during behavioural testing and the paper states mice were isolated into individual cages two days before testing.
day_night_flipped = 'no' (modal; paper states a natural 16:8 light-dark cycle, i.e., not reversed).
HTR B1 scored 0 (single measure); gemma's score of 1 for '1 measure' contradicts rubric. HTR time_to_assay = 5 min after the 25CN-NBOH challenge (modal).
OFT B1 = 4-6 (5 measures; score 2); light-dark box B1 = 4-6 (4 measures in Table 4; score 2, modal score).
MWM B2 overridden to 0 (deepseek/gemma scored 1): the learning curve uses training day as a between-session factor, which the rubric explicitly excludes; within-trial means were averaged per day.
MWM D2 = 0 (<15 min): trials 60 s with 15-s ITI; deepseek's score of 1 contradicted its own evidence.
MWM water_restriction set to 'during' (no drinking water source) for consistency with E8 = No, overriding the modal 'no'.

Startle/PPI setup_habituation set to not_reported: the 3-min adaptation is within the test session, which the rubric excludes. setup_restrain = 'yes' (modal), medium confidence since restraint holder is not explicitly described.
Startle direction = 'increase' (modal): 25CN-NBOH increased startle amplitude, and PPI was unchanged.
time_to_assay for chronic-treatment assays coded early_2to24h / 1440 min (modal), medium confidence; the paper only states injections were given at least 1 h after behavioural experiments.
